name: rosetta-comma-quibbling
code:
use default

quibble(words: string[]) -> string =>
    case words.count
    when 0 then "\{\}"
    when 1 then "\{{words[0]}\}"
    else (
        let front = words[0..<1] |> join(", ")

        "\{{front} and {words[words.count - 1]}\}"
    )
    esac

let examples: string[][] =
    [[], ["ABC"], ["ABC", "DEF"], ["ABC", "DEF", "G", "H"]]

for words in examples do
    write_line(quibble(words))
od
